line.name: La Validación
line.description: Aganorsa Leaf's 2022 rebrand/packaging update unifying its four core lines (Corojo, Maduro, Connecticut, Habano) under standardized 15-count boxing, a redesigned band, and 3 shared vitolas. Announced at PCA 2022; Habano/Connecticut shipped late May 2022, Corojo/Maduro shipped July 2022. The underlying blends are largely the same tobacco program as before, not new recipes - some legacy sizes (e.g. Connecticut Churchill, Corojo Torpedo) were discontinued in the transition. Sold broadly at major retailers (JR Cigars, Corona Cigar, Cigars International, Atlantic Cigar, Famous Smoke), not a retailer exclusive.
line.notes: Wrapper/binder/filler/strength below are sourced from aganorsaleaf.com (manufacturer marketing) - not independently corroborated by a halfwheel review in this research pass; treat with slightly more caution than other entries in this batch.

research_notes: Not on the site at all. The site instead lists the pre-2022 legacy names (Aniversario Corojo, Aniversario Maduro, Connecticut, Habano) which La Validación appears to supersede/rebrand, though the exact naming correspondence between 'La Validación Corojo' and 'Aniversario Corojo' was not explicitly confirmed by any single source - recommend the user check whether these should replace or sit alongside the existing site entries. A separate limited retailer-exclusive vitola, 'La Validación Corojo Gran Corona' (for Twins Smoke Shop's 25th anniversary), also exists but is a one-off special release, not part of the core series - not included here.
